data.name: Private Patch Reef Fishing
data.headline: Light-tackle reef fishing aboard the 30' Jeanneau yacht
data.description:
A guided light-tackle fishing charter to the patch reefs of the Lower Keys aboard the 30' Jeanneau yacht. Snapper, grouper, jacks, and the occasional permit — all caught within a few miles of Key West. Your USCG-licensed captain doubles as your fishing guide: he knows the reefs by GPS coordinates AND by memory. All rods, reels, tackle, and live or cut bait included. Catch-clean-cook arrangements with local restaurants available on request.

Quick facts: 

• 4 hrs $1,395 
• 6 hrs $1,595 
• 8 hrs $1,795 
• Private 
• USCG-licensed captain 
• All gear included 
• Perry Hotel & Marina

data.itinerary:
Departure – Perry Hotel & Marina
Meet your captain at Dock A, Slip #32. After a safety briefing and gear overview, we cruise toward nearby patch reef systems.

Primary Patch Reef Fishing
Anchor or drift over productive reef structures located a few miles offshore. Drop lines directly over structure targeting snapper, grouper, porgies, hogfish (season permitting), and other reef species.

Technique Variation
Depending on conditions and bite patterns, we may incorporate:
• Light trolling for mackerel and bonito
• Seasonal mahi-mahi opportunities
• Drift fishing along reef edges

Return Cruise
Relax on the ride back with your catch on ice and stories to tell.

data.booking_notes:
IMPORTANT ACTION REQUIRED
Six Fins Charter – Patch Reef Fishing Confirmation

Dear Guests,

We’re excited to welcome you aboard your Private Patch Reef Fishing Charter in Key West.

Whether you're chasing snapper for dinner or simply enjoying a relaxed day on the water, we look forward to hosting your adventure.

Please review the important details below to ensure a smooth and successful trip.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

✅ Before Your Trip

For trips up to six passengers:

👉 Each passenger must complete the insurance waiver (including adults on behalf of minors): [here] (https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/rd9k5tiavpwper7h2rhaqh/web/)

For trips with 7th and 8th passengers:

👉 The primary renter (21+ years old) must complete the Bareboat Contract prior to arrival: [here] (https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/gntbqof57vuo1dg62v383i/web/

All required forms must be completed before arrival so we may depart on time.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🎣 Your Fishing Experience

You’ve reserved a private charter for:

4 Hours – $1,395
6 Hours – $1,595
8 Hours – $1,795

We’ll target productive patch reefs just a few miles offshore near areas such as:

• Sand Key Reef
• Western Sambo Reef
• Eastern Dry Rocks
• Rock Key

Target species may include:

• Yellowtail Snapper
• Mangrove Snapper
• Mutton Snapper
• Grouper (seasonal regulations apply)
• Hogfish (season permitting)
• Porgies
• Spanish Mackerel
• Bonito
• Seasonal mahi-mahi

Fishing success varies daily — but we’ll work hard to keep rods bent and lines tight.

All tackle and gear are provided. Your catch will be iced onboard.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

Dock A, Slip #32
7001 Shrimp Rd

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🩺 Health & Safety

Your safety is our highest priority.

• Operated by U.S. Coast Guard–licensed captains

Guests should be comfortable standing, handling rods, and moving safely on deck.

Excessive intoxication or unsafe behavior may result in denial of boarding or early termination without refund.

Captains reserve the right to modify location or return early due to weather or sea conditions.

David McFadden
